# recovered-from-issue: https://github.com/sdv-dev/SDV/issues/2716

TITLE
HMASynthesizer - Cap displayed column count in PerformanceAlert Message

BODY
### Environment Details

Please indicate the following details about the environment in which you found the bug:

* SDV version: 1.27.0
* Python version: 3.13
* Operating System: macOS

### Error Description

Currently, the `PerformanceAlert` message shows the exact number of columns that would be generated when using the `HMASynthesizer` on certain large metadata schemas.

Here is a `PerformanceAlert` I got using a very large metadata schema:
```
PerformanceAlert: Using the HMASynthesizer on this metadata schema is not recommended. 
To model this data, HMA will generate a large number of columns. 
( columns)
```

### Expected Behavior

Introduce a maximum display cap for the column count in the alert message to 1000000.
````
PerformanceAlert: Using the HMASynthesizer on this metadata schema is not recommended. 
To model this data, HMA will generate a large number of columns. (1000000+ columns)
```

Also, if possible, cap the computation that if the number is already exceeding 1000000 to stop computing and print the performance alert.
